opportunities.title: Research Awards (Grants of £500 to £5,000 for research into the human past)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through material culture or material remains. No period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions; encourages archaeology, art history, architectural history, material culture studies, history of collecting and related fields. Early‑career researchers welcomed. Projects must have the Society as main or significant financial contributor and not be for undergraduate/ postgraduate degree work.

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales and Open Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support research archaeology in Wales (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright) and open‑research projects. Applications are accepted from the project director or principal investigator; early‑career researchers are encouraged. Funding amounts are not specified on the page.

opportunities.title: Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Annual grants named after Beatrice di Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, and William Lambarde. Applications are accepted from the project director or principal investigator; early‑career researchers are welcomed. No specific funding amount is stated on the page.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator.
opportunities.summary: Two annual application rounds (31 March and 31 August) for grants supporting church conservation projects. Applications are accepted from the project director or principal investigator. No specific funding amount is provided on the page.
